resonance_harbour_agitation.geometry: narrow-mouth rectangular harbour (Lh=500 m, mouth 25 m) coupled to open sea, constant depth 10 m
resonance_harbour_agitation.mode_shape: standing wave, ~3 half-waves along harbour; wavelength cT=317 m matches half-wave mode n=3 (analytic 33.7 s vs measured 32 s, +5%)
resonance_harbour_agitation.citation: closed/semi-open basin seiche ladder T_n=2L/(n sqrt(gh)) (Wilson 1972; standard harbour resonance theory)

breakwater_diffraction_sommerfeld.geometry: semi-infinite thin breakwater, tip mid-domain, constant depth 10 m, monochromatic T=8 s (wavelength 70.9 m)
breakwater_diffraction_sommerfeld.citation: Sommerfeld (1896) / Penny & Price (1952) semi-infinite rigid screen diffraction; Kd=0.5 on the shadow-boundary ray

berkhoff_elliptic_shoal.geometry: EXACT Berkhoff-Booij-Radder (1982) elliptic shoal on a 1:50 beach rotated 20 deg (corfon bathymetry from official bosse_elliptique), monochromatic T=1 s, incident H=0.0464 m, dx=0.15 m
berkhoff_elliptic_shoal.note: shoreline singularity (depth->0, breaking off) excluded (depth>0.12 m); caustic offset laterally by the 20 deg shoal rotation, as in the experiment
